description: Get the most recent runtime logs for one app. Call this when an app is crashing, returning errors, or a deploy succeeded but the app misbehaves: the logs usually name the cause. At most 32 KB, the newest lines; a line says where older ones were left out.

app_id.description: The app id returned by list_apps

tail.description: Number of recent log lines to return (max 200, default 100)

name: get_app_logs
title: Get app logs
